race.comment: Looks another nice race for SAVVIE BLANC (1) who was a last-start winner over this route in similar company, coming from just off the speed in a field of four to win nicely. More rivals here but he's racing well and should take holding out again. LIFE SENTENCE (3) wasn't beaten far in a slightly stronger race here last time out when boxing on for a narrow fifth. He can lead or be right there this time and give a sight. WATT ON EARTH (6) was outclassed at Flemington last time but had been a good winner over this route two back, beating LIFE SENTENCE (who was favourite), so he must be included. QUELLO DORATO (5) was a winner here in easier company last time but goes in from VALIDATED (4) who is racing well.
